system.description:
The Abyssal explodes from stillness into terrifying motion, covering the distance between predator and prey in a single impossible leap suffused with deathly essence. This charm supplements a Rush action or movement-based attack, allowing the Exalted to leap up to (Strength + Athletics) × 5 yards as a single movement, arriving at her destination already in the midst of an attack. The target of the leap must succeed on a Valor roll at difficulty 2 or suffer a two-die penalty on their next action from the shock of the approach.

The Obvious quality of this charm is apparent in the unnatural arc of the leap and the bone-chilling shriek of displaced grave-wind that accompanies the Abyssal's passage. This charm is prerequisite to the Hungry Ghost Form, which transforms this explosive mobility into a sustained state of predatory prowess.
